None. Terminal states are immutable; corrections are new evidence rows, never state edits.

invariants: Every guaranteed deliverable in a purchase snapshot has exactly one root obligation row; substitutes are additional rows that reference substitute_of.
State history is append-only: (from, to, at, actor, trigger, evidence_ref?). A row is never updated in place.
No obligation may enter LIVE without at least one evidence row; no obligation may enter COMPLETED without the reconciliation gate.
BLOCKED and NEEDS_OWNER are internal states. The seller renderer maps them to the plan line unchanged (“Scheduled as part of your campaign”) and never to a cause.
A BLOCKED obligation has a deadline = window.latest − channel lead time; the monitor advances the ladder at the deadline rather than letting the window lapse silently.
Only an Owner resolution can move an obligation out of NEEDS_OWNER; the runtime never times a NEEDS_OWNER row into a terminal state on its own.
Consent, suppression, frequency caps, readiness and health checks are evaluated at transition time, not at plan time; a transition whose guard fails becomes BLOCKED, never forced.
